title: Sandy Dreams Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sandy Dreams is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionSANDY DREAMSSeacrest Beach CommunityLifeguard Loop West, Panama City Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights5 bedrooms (see room configurations under “Room Details”)4 bathroomsSleeps 12 guests2,250 sq. ft.King master suite with vaulted ceiling, en suite bathroom with dual showerheads, and a walk-in closet large enough for a pack ‘n playBacks up to a wooded nature preserve and walking trail for added privacyMarble countertops in kitchen and all bathroomsTwo bunk rooms to accommodate various sleeping arrangementsScreened-in back porch with 6-person dining tableDownstairs grill areaSpacious laundry roomFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not provided; additional rentals available upon request)About Sandy DreamsWelcome to Sandy Dreams, a charming cottage tucked behind Seacrest’s wooded nature preserve, offering peace, privacy, and prime access to the beach just a short 5-minute walk away. Perfect for up to 12 guests, the home features flexible sleeping options with two guest rooms on the main floor and two bunk rooms upstairs.The luxurious king master suite upstairs boasts a soaring vaulted ceiling trimmed in natural wood, an en suite bathroom with a glass-front shower and dual shower-heads, and a walk-in closet spacious enough to serve as a nursery with a portable crib.Entertain effortlessly in the chef’s kitchen with marble countertops and stainless steel appliances, flowing into the open living and dining area with a large flat-screen TV. For outdoor dining and relaxation, the screened-in back porch overlooks the serene nature preserve, and the brick patio below offers additional seating and a gas grill.Community AmenitiesSeacrest Beach, FL, offers an unbeatable location near top dining and shopping along Scenic Highway 30A. Guests can easily explore the Village of Seacrest, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach on foot or by bike.12,000 sq. ft. lagoon-style community pool with waterfalls, fountains, and bathhousesPrivate community beach accessComplimentary tram service (March–October) to the beach and throughout the communityPedestrian-friendly paths and serene walking trailsClose proximity to restaurants, shops, and entertainmentNote: Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach Community.ParkingDriveway parking for 1 vehicleStreet parking available on a first-come, first-served basisAdditional off-street parking near Seacrest Village shops and restaurantsNo trailers allowed. Vehicles must park in designated lined spaces with a valid parking permit/hangtagBooking & PoliciesNo smokingNo pets (service animals only; documentation required)Rates do not include taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrivalCancellations more than 60 days prior: initial 50% payment is refundable minus a 5% processing feeOptional travel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment)Check-in: 6:00 PM (CST) | Check-out: 12:00 PM (CST) (Starting Jan 1, 2026: Check-in 4:00 PM | Check-out 10:00 AM)Tenants must be at least 25 years old
